caption: The drawing depicts a single doll-like figure standing in the center of a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or scenery. The figure is female, with light skin and a round face featuring red cheeks, red lips, and black eyebrows and eyes. The hair is black, parted in the middle, and styled in thick waves around the head. The figure wears a cream-colored, one-piece undergarment with short sleeves and pant legs ending just below the knees, trimmed with lace. The undergarment is decorated with a brown cross around the neck and ties at the shoulders. The arms and hands are visible and painted in light pink. The legs are mostly covered by the undergarment, with parts of the bare knees and shin exposed, and the figure wears black ankle boots with blue and red details. At the bottom right corner of the beige background, the name "Rex Bush" is signed in black script.
title: Greiner Doll "Minerva"
